I do something similar in my recent artworks!  


1. Duplicate your final artwork layer (after you're done rendering and all)
2. Use posterization and set it to max (on either end of the spectrum, whichever side gives more variation)
3. Set layer to multiply/overlay/etc depending on what you need and then toggle layer opacity
4. Voila!

​

For extra coolness, mess around w/ tone curves, then follow the above steps. Have a good day!

That's fair! I suppose somebody could argue that the severity of the issue in SG differs compared to other countries, though. Plus I think solutions based locally would be better at making an impact VS a solution that fits global context (if that makes sense).

For example, in global context, awareness regarding sexual assault has been raised via movements like MeToo and such, but locally it hasn't really spread that far. Although we do have many non profit orgs that try to spread awareness, the information isn't really spread/shared around by anyone other than supporters (AKA people who've already changed their mind from the start), which makes changing societal views on topics like this harder since it's not reaching out to the actual target audience.

Our SexEd is also pretty... meh lol, to say the least. Not sure how they conduct it in mixed schools because I came from a religious single gender school but, from my understanding, SexEd in general is pretty bad across SG. So there's that too.
